verdict.rationale: Freshsales marketing pages claim it automates repetitive tasks, uses Freddy AI to capture, qualify and route leads, and offers sales sequences. These suggest background automation, but nothing documents how automations are configured, what triggers them, or that they run unattended. missing for 10: documented workflow/automation rule configuration, trigger and scheduling details (one-off versus recurring), evidence of autonomous background execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Eliminate manual effort and save time by automating repetitive, mundane tasks.
capture, qualify, route, and track them with the power of Freddy AI.
